note: v2606: overlap_ratchet shipped at v2605 with no unit suite and its own gate why said so out loud. One version earlier I had been bitten by exactly that shape - reel_templates had classified all forty of his reels since v2571 with nothing testing it, REG-586. Shipping the same shape twice in two versions is how a rule becomes a thing you write down instead of a thing you do. 12 cases, no browser - a rise fails and NAMES the width, a FALL fails too so a win is recorded rather than absorbed as slack, an unmeasurable run is UNKNOWN and never a pass, an absent baseline is UNCONFIGURED rather than clean, and a malformed count is not read as zero. It pins the 3px threshold as deliberate and it pins that each width is graded on a first paint - including the honest note that the reload changed NOTHING and is there because it is the right thing to measure, not because it fixed a defect. Proven RED by making a rise pass. My first cut of the unconfigured-baseline case asserted the modules wording against my own stub - grading the fixture instead of the code - and it exercises the real _baseline now.
